paper_title: Stochastic fluctuations of bosonic dark matter
notes: Methodology/theory paper. It derives a stochastic correction factor (gamma_95%^stoch ~ 2.7-10 x gamma_95%^det, Eq. 7) accounting for the Rayleigh-distributed VULF amplitude in the T << tau_c regime, and applies it to REINTERPRET previously published constraints. Figure 3 shows a 'modified constraint' (green Stochastic line vs gray Deterministic) for the axion-nucleon coupling g_aNN, but these curves are rescalings of prior experiments' data (refs [32-34,66]: CASPEr-ZULF and related comagnetometer searches), not a new measured limit from an experiment performed here. Similarly the SM shows modified dilaton exclusions. Per the task card, reinterpretations of other experiments' data are not new limits unless the paper derives a new bound from its own data; no new experimental/observational exclusion is presented. Reported is_new_limit=false. coupling_convention field set to the plane the paper's illustrative Fig.3 concerns (axion-nucleon) but no points emitted.
